headline: Mexican Peso Recovers Below 18 Per Dollar After Recent Depreciation
summary: The Mexican peso strengthened back to the 18 units per dollar level on Friday following weeks of depreciation driven by central bank rate differential expectations.
why: The Mexican peso is one of the most liquid emerging market currencies, heavily influenced by U.S. trade policies and interest rate differentials.

impacts.name: USD/MXN
impacts.why: The exchange rate moved down to the 18 pesos per dollar range.
impacts.baseline_rule: first recorded price at or after created_at (15-minute price recorder); end = first price at least 24 h later, within 48 h

why_moved: The Mexican peso rebounded as U.S. dollar buying paused near 18 pesos per dollar.
